photo.context: 宇宙観測に関連する素材写真。REPTile-3の写真ではない。

paragraphs.text: NASA reported on 1 October 2026 that a small particle detector called REPTile-3 had been incorporated into the Emirates Mission to the Asteroid Belt. The mission is scheduled to launch in March 2028. It has not yet begun its journey. The detector will study energetic particles, helping scientists understand the radiation environment far from Earth and plan for future exploration.
paragraphs.translationJa: NASAは2026年10月1日、小型の粒子検出器REPTile-3がエミレーツ小惑星帯探査計画に組み込まれたと報告した。打ち上げは2028年3月の予定で、まだ飛行を開始していない。検出器は高エネルギー粒子を調べ、地球から遠い場所の放射線環境の理解と将来の探査計画に役立てる。

paragraphs.text: The instrument builds on an earlier detector, REPTile-2, carried by the CIRBE satellite. CIRBE entered low Earth orbit in April 2023. Although the satellite was roughly the size of a shoebox, it collected detailed measurements of electrons and protons. This earlier work showed that compact equipment could provide useful information about particles surrounding our planet. A small instrument need not produce a small scientific contribution.
paragraphs.translationJa: 装置の基礎となるのは、CIRBE衛星に搭載された先行機REPTile-2だ。CIRBEは2023年4月に地球低軌道へ入った。衛星は靴箱ほどの大きさだったが、電子と陽子を詳しく測定した。この先行研究は、小型装置でも地球を取り巻く粒子について有用な情報を集められることを示した。装置が小さいからといって、科学への貢献も小さいとは限らない。

paragraphs.text: NASA explained in February 2025 that CIRBE data revealed two temporary radiation belts after the powerful solar storm of May 2024. A radiation belt is a region containing energetic particles held by Earth's magnetic field. Such particles can damage spacecraft and put astronauts at risk. Understanding changes in these regions is therefore relevant to safety, rather than simply to making a map of space.
paragraphs.translationJa: NASAは2025年2月、2024年5月の強い太陽嵐の後に生じた二つの一時的な放射線帯を、CIRBEのデータから確認したと説明した。放射線帯は地球の磁場に捕らえられた高エネルギー粒子が存在する領域だ。こうした粒子は宇宙機を傷つけ、宇宙飛行士を危険にさらす可能性がある。その変化を理解することは、宇宙の地図を作るだけでなく安全にも関わる。

paragraphs.text: CIRBE's observations also had limits. A fault stopped its measurements in April 2024, so it was silent during the May storm itself. The satellite resumed collecting data in June. Its later measurements helped researchers identify the new belts. This sequence matters: detecting a storm's effects afterwards is different from observing every stage while the storm is happening.
paragraphs.translationJa: CIRBEの観測にも限界があった。2024年4月に故障して測定が止まり、5月の太陽嵐そのものが起きている間は動作していなかった。6月にデータ収集を再開し、その後の測定が新しい放射線帯の特定に役立った。この順序は重要だ。後から嵐の影響を検出することと、発生中の全過程を観測することは異なる。

paragraphs.text: For REPTile-3, the team widened the field of view and changed part of the sensor to measure lower-energy protons. The planned route extends from inside Venus's orbit to beyond Mars and into the asteroid belt. The mission will provide another perspective on how solar particles spread. Its results remain future possibilities, but its design connects experience near Earth with questions about deeper space.
paragraphs.translationJa: REPTile-3では視野を広げ、より低いエネルギーの陽子を測れるようセンサーの一部を変更した。予定する航路は金星の軌道の内側から火星の先、小惑星帯へと延びる。太陽由来の粒子がどう広がるかを別の位置から調べられる見込みだ。成果はまだ将来の可能性だが、設計は地球近傍で得た経験と、より遠い宇宙の問いを結びつけている。

comprehension.question: When is the asteroid mission scheduled to launch?
choices: In March 2028, according to the current plan.
In April 2023, together with the CIRBE satellite.
In May 2024, while the solar storm was occurring.
In February 2025, when NASA reported the belts.

evidence.text: The mission is scheduled to launch in March 2028.

comprehension.explanationJa: 本文中の根拠に基づいて判断します。

comprehension.question: What did CIRBE's later data help researchers identify?
choices: Two temporary belts after the May 2024 storm.
A new planet outside the orbit of the Earth.
A permanent change to the route of all asteroids.
A complete absence of protons near the planet.

evidence.text: NASA explained in February 2025 that CIRBE data revealed two temporary radiation belts after the powerful solar storm of May 2024.

comprehension.explanationJa: 本文中の根拠に基づいて判断します。

comprehension.question: Why should CIRBE not be described as observing the whole storm?
choices: It collected data again only after the May event.
It had never measured any particles before May.
It had reached the asteroid belt before June.
It measured only sunlight throughout the event.

evidence.text: A fault stopped its measurements in April 2024, so it was silent during the May storm itself.
highlights: silent during the May storm itself
